title: My debut album comes out May 20th! You can preorder yours now at jackruch.com #supportsmallcreators
text: Hey guys, I'm proud to announce my debut album is coming out May 20th. We just received CDs the other day and we've got vinyl on the way. You can pre-order everything now at my website jackruch.com. And go stream the title track wherever you stream music. This was a real labor of love making this record and I was lucky enough to work with some of my musical heroes, the great Dennis Chambers on drums and Gary Grainger on bass from John Scofield's band and Mike Stern's band, some of my childhood musical heroes. We've also got Brandon Woody on trumpet and Adam Wakefield on keyboards. This is real original music made by real human beings live in the room. No click tracks, no auto-tune, no AI, just real art and we'd love your support.
